notes: Modified cash basis village, FYE 9/30/2025; basis recorded as cash. Governmental amounts from Total column of the governmental funds statement (p4: General, Street, Park, Library, Cemetery, CRA). Utility funds (Water, Sewer, Garbage, Keno) Total column of proprietary statement (p6) are business-type; business_type.measure net position (statement includes depreciation and capital assets). Beginning cash 116,633 is the printed beginning net position/fund balance (cash basis; no separate cash line for governmental only; p8 shows all-funds beginning cash 723,832 incl. proprietary). Roll-forward gov: 116,633 + 926,303 - 1,025,918 = 17,018; BT: 1,445,402 + 415,913 - 430,495 = 1,430,820. No transfers, no debt proceeds shown. Governmental spending lists by object only; each object line is split by fund column (split_from) and given the fund's function (General general government, Street streets/highways, Park/Library culture/recreation, Cemetery health/welfare, CRA economic development) with review. Detail: only the all-funds Budget and Actual schedule (p7) is a supplementary schedule; it combines governmental and business-type funds, so fund_type is assigned per line by obvious utility lines (Wastewater, Water, Solid waste business-type; others governmental, charges for services mixed); the all-funds Capital outlay 117,229 and Debt service 176,105 lines are split by fund type using the governmental amounts on p4 (business-type remainders computed; governmental debt interest/fees 12,869 are already inside the p7 function lines, so only principal 135,000 is governmental and the business-type remainder 41,105 is utility principal). Items sum to printed totals 1,342,216 and 1,497,104. Fund-column breakdowns on p3-6 not repeated in detail. Balance sheet uses the government-wide Statement of Net Position, 2025 Total column.
